title: Cellular Hypoxia and Metabolic Decompensation in Shock
author: Panthro at English Wikipedia
caption: Cellular mechanism diagram illustrating how inadequate oxygen delivery during shock shifts metabolism toward anaerobic glycolysis, lactic acidosis, and cellular injury.
